summary: config.py holds the AWS documentation example key pair as literal values. The pair is rated critical under the checklist. No other hard-coded secrets were found: the payments token is read from the environment.

findings.title: AWS access key ID hard-coded (documentation example key)
findings.evidence: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = "AKIA..." (the AWS documentation example ID, ending in EXAMPLE)
findings.recommendation: Remove the literal and read the key from the environment or a secret store, or use an IAM role. If the key was ever real, rotate it.

findings.title: AWS secret access key hard-coded (documentation example key)
findings.recommendation: Remove the literal and load the secret from the environment or a secret manager. Rotate it if it was ever real.

limitations: The repository has only 5 files, and I read all of them except requirements.txt.
I did not check git history.
